method: Raw replay records are unchanged. Monitor passes additionally require the latest transcript's interpretation to finish before the replay observation window closes. Observed false-alert exposure always fails. Latency cohorts retain their denominators and include only passing cases; do not compare conditional speed without pass rates. Multi-utterance first-final timing is not pooled with single-announcement ASR latency. WER/CER use NFKC, casefold, punctuation removal and whitespace normalization; number words are not converted to digits. CER counts Unicode code points excluding spaces, not grapheme clusters. Task-level target/counter accuracy remains primary. Optional explicit label reviews are applied uniformly; original client verdicts and the review reasons remain in each case. Wrong/missing counters are counted separately from unexpected or wrong-target alert exposure.
